text:
Priya Patel: Heads up — partner is aiming to announce next Tuesday. We need final SOC2 attestation + pen-test report presigned artifacts routed to their SI. Who owns the upload + redaction?
Diego Morales: I can own the S3 presigns and upload process. ETA?
Priya Patel: thanks Diego. partner wants docs available by Monday EOD PST. Also need a short attestation letter from sec/compliance.
Samir Khan: for pen test, do we have the signed scope + PO back from the vendor? I thought that was stuck with procurement.
julie (partner-eng): procurement confirmed yesterday — scope signed, vendor onboarding in progress. Pen window opens this week.
Diego Morales: planning checklist: presign bucket, TTL 7 days, redaction flag, owner tag = partnerships/julie. I'll share commands.
Diego Morales: ```aws s3 presign s3://redwood-marketplace/partner-evidence/2026-03- -r --expires-in 604800```
Hannah Lee: I'll handle redaction. Need list of filenames and regexes to scrub (emails, internal IPs, full ARNs). Send me a sample.
Priya Patel: @Hannah Lee sent sample list to your DM. Can you return scrubbed copies and a redaction report by Sun 10am PST?
Hannah Lee: yep. timeline looks tight but doable. Will surface anything that looks like source-code leaks. :eyes:
Samir Khan: security note — we should include a one-page blurb for the marketplace listing about what the pen test covered (in scannable bullets). I'll draft.
sec-bot: Reminder: upload artifacts must be stored in encrypted S3 with KMS key alias/marketplace-evidence and access logs enabled.
Diego Morales: acknowledged. I'll configure bucket-policy + kms alias and post the presign links in a secure HMACed note to the SI.
Priya Patel: also need questionnaire answers (vendor Qs + standard marketplace security questionnaire). Julie, can you collect the SI's extra Qs?
julie (partner-eng): on it. pinging SI now, will collate by Sat afternoon.
Samir Khan: Ping re: attestation letter — can legal issue a short statement confirming control scope and SOC2 coverage? Who owns that?
Priya Patel: legal ownership is with me but I'll coordinate with compliance. Expect draft by Sun noon.
Diego Morales: final ask — can each owner drop a single bullet confirmation here when done: presigns, redaction, attestation, questionnaire, pen-report upload? makes rollout checklist easy.
Hannah Lee: redaction - assigned, will post confirm here when uploaded.
samir khan: pen-report - assigned to procurement/vendor, I'll monitor and confirm upload.
julie (partner-eng): questionnaire - I'll deliver collated answers.
Priya Patel: attestation - I'll confirm when legal signs off.
Diego Morales: presigns + KMS setup - I'll post links as soon as bucket ready.
Priya Patel: Great team, thanks. If any blockers surface please flag early. :thumbsup:
